name: Duangtawan Hotel
detail: It was comfortable and nice to feel together while being separated from the kids. The room was spacious and had chairs and a table, which made it nice to gather and have snacks. The staff started cleaning early every morning. When we went for breakfast, they were cleaning. We were on the 21st floor, and there was no outside noise; it was quiet. I saw many comments saying it was outdated, but it wasn't something we were concerned about, so it wasn't bad. The air conditioning worked well, and the view was nice. The location is excellent. There are many good restaurants nearby, and it was easy to get around with Grab or Bolt. When I was too lazy to go out for breakfast, I used the breakfast service, and it had everything you'd expect, so I was satisfied. There was a 2000 baht deposit, and I didn’t experience any inconveniences during my stay. The pool water was clean and well-maintained. I recommend it for family trips.

name: Villa Lantara Chiang Mai
detail: The building is new, and the room furniture is stylish. The staff is kind. And above all, having red dragon fruit and mangosteen for breakfast is the best. There are plenty of other fruits as well. It's a shame the shower is fixed, but it is a good hotel with high cost performance. It was also nice to have a toothbrush and conditioner. For breakfast, there is a plate made by the staff and a simple buffet, and you can request Thai food with a reservation made the day before.
area: Old City,Chiang Mai - View on map

name: Palette Luxe Elephant Camp Maerim
detail: This is a nice place in the countryside. It is in a beautiful and peaceful part of Chiang Mai. I probably got the best sleep here than anywhere else in Thailand so far! The pictures do match the property, but there is not a restaurant there yet. However, breakfast is covered. We stayed nine days and had a different dish for breakfast almost every day. Chen, who is the main staff member, does a WONDERFUL job maintaining the property. He went out of his way to make sure we were more than comfortable, so if you have any questions at all, please don't hesitate to ask him! He is very thoughtful and will definitely make your stay an enjoyable one! The pool was lovely. A bit chilly at times but still refreshing. I loved sitting outside and watching the butterflies. 😊 Also, please go into the little town there! The locals are so welcoming and kind, and the food at the two restaurants we went to was so good! Try the BBQ from the lady grilling on the side of the road. If you're looking for more of a traditional restaurant, check out the place at 3009 Saluang (well within walking distance). Everything we ate there was delicious and the view at sunset was lovely. Having said all that, the main issue is how far away from downtown Chiang Mai it is, and it was really only an issue because we didn't realize how far it is. If you don't have your own transportation (like we didn't), it can be a bit challenging. Bolt and Grab don't accurately reflect how much it will cost to get a cab to take you there from downtown Chiang Mai, so in reality, expect to pay 1,000 Baht one way, give or take. It does make sense, though, because it's about an hour away. However, the property does have a reliable taxi guy who will take you around, including to/from downtown Chiang Mai (for a little cheaper into downtown than Grab/Bolt); just give the property a heads up that you'll need transport. I recommend using him. If you have an international driver's license, I do believe they have a scooter you can rent just to get around the local area. We just walked. Overall, we still very much enjoyed our stay. It was nice to get away from.the city for awhile and it got us to step out of our comfort zone a little, which was nice. Especially if you have your own transport and are looking for a little peace and quiet, I'd recommend it 😊

name: Nature Boutique Hotel at Chiangmai
detail: It wasn't bad for a man to stay alone. It was a room with a private bathroom, but the parking space was narrow, making it difficult to park my motorcycle. However, the owner came out every time to make space for me, and I was very grateful for that.

name: Collection O Lai Thai Guesthouse
detail: Excellent service, the staff welcomed us warmly, convenient parking, not far from Tha Phae Gate. I really liked it.
area: Old City,Chiang Mai - View on map

name: Hotel Montha
detail: Stayed for 2 nights and then added 2 more nights. The exterior of the hotel looks dated, but the interior is very clean. The bedding is fluffy. All the staff greet with a smile. After breakfast, from 11 AM, there is coffee and a small selection of bread and fruits available. It's not a 5-star, but the cost-performance ratio is excellent. There is one downside... no elevator. I have frequently visited Chiang Mai, but I regret finding this place late.
area: Night Bazaar,Chiang Mai - View on map

name: Top North Hotel
detail: Anyway, the location is great. It’s in the city center but located in a quiet area, so it’s calm at night. Initially, I stayed in a room on the first floor, but when I mentioned that the shower wasn’t providing hot water, they quickly moved me to a room on the second floor. The staff's attitude was very nice.
area: Old City,Chiang Mai - View on map

name: Royal Panerai Hotel Chiangmai
detail: The hotel is located just beyond the northeast corner of Old City, making it easy to explore the entire area on foot, including Thapae Gate. There is a convenience store and restaurant right in front of the hotel, and nearby are the Chang Phuak Market and Lotus, adding to the convenience of daily life. The facilities are in good condition for their age, and the rooms are spacious and clean. The tap water is in decent condition. The color of the filtered shower head is at an acceptable level. The staff are very friendly and responsive to requests. Free instant coffee is available until 10 a.m. and it’s delicious. There is ample parking space. Considering the cost-effectiveness, I highly recommend this hotel. I plan to stay here again on my next trip.

name: Collection O Baan Elephant Home
detail: This hotel was perfect for our family vacation. The kids loved the pool, while we enjoyed the relaxing atmosphere and friendly service. Everything was clean, organized, and conveniently located near attractions.
area: Old City,Chiang Mai - View on map

name: ON Thapae Gate Chiangmai
detail: The staff is friendly, I liked the breakfast, the airport is close, and everything is good. However, in the evening, the nearby area consists mainly of bars, making it a bit inconvenient for family dining. I think it would be great for young travelers.
